findings.classification: Strong source+log evidence of fixture path-string mismatch, not absence of native registration.
findings.observed: Windows log22:48:07.071 Create run configuration;22:48:07.075 TEMPORARY Go Test TestHost;22:48:07.083 Execute. The10second RunManager listener latch nevertheless times out.
findings.source: Producer stores source.directory from VirtualFile parent (system-independent C:/ form); fixture passes Path.toString C:\ form. Listener compares raw strings at GoNativeGutterInvocation line51. Existing platform action genuinely created/executed configuration.
findings.proposal: Test-only pure Path.normalize comparison with absolute expected directory. No toRealPath/IO on EDT; no extra timeout, skip, manual configuration or simulated action. Preserve actual RunManager event, popup perform, test pattern and selected command.
findings.needed: Actual Windows same cohort and gutter callers; log both normalized directories on future mismatch. This does not broaden production path-alias semantics.

findings.classification: Observed process-exit-oracle disagreement; physical exit confirmation required before assigning production versus fixture fault.
findings.observed: Rejected registration test lasts0.489s. process.onExit().get(8s) returns, immediate process.isAlive remains true. This is the adapter, not sentinel-child assertion. Raw XML has no process implementation/start identity/real exit code or later exit observation at this failure point.
findings.source: GoDebugDescriptor catch activates startNotify then destroys exact owned handler and rethrows; termination is asynchronous BGT. GoOwnedDapAdapterProcessHandler also uses onExit to disable fallback timers. Therefore a proven early/exceptional completion issue could matter to production; do not dismiss the failure as only flaky.

primaryApiSource.fact: OpenJDK25 base Windows waitFor uses the owned process handle; onExit is ProcessHandleImpl.completion(pid,false).handleAsync returning this regardless of callback throwable. isAlive uses its native process handle.
primaryApiSource.limit: Primary25base source, not a byte-identical audit of the actual JetBrains25.0.3 runtime. No exact API root cause established.

findings.proposal: Test-only switch the existing8second cleanup barrier to actual process.waitFor(8s), retain isAlive/no disconnect/no launch assertions. Record onExit completion, process class/PID/start and actual exitValue/handler state in subsequent real evidence. This is a physical-exit barrier, not a widened timeout.
findings.needed: Actual Windows rejected-registration rerun. If waitFor or physical exit fails, treat as production RED. If onExit proves early completion, separately review production deadline logic: delayed actions should still re-check actual isAlive; no production change proposed here without that evidence.

findings.classification: Potential production cancellation/descendant ownership gap; not justified as timeout-only fixture failure.
findings.observed: The real worker future did not return in5s after EDT cancel; it had already seen owned.json with helper parent+child alive. Operation.future is cancelled immediately; that does not prove BGT teardown completed.
findings.source: Actual Windows execute uses JDK ProcessBuilder pipes, not PTY. Main loop calls checkCurrent before process.descendants sampling; cancelling before this sample throws to finally. Windows stop kills only cached children, never refreshes live descendants. A child spawned before owned.json may be missing from the map and survive parent kill, keeping output pipes open while stream close/join runs.
findings.inferenceBoundary: This code ordering is a concrete missing-coverage path and fits the failure. No worker/native thread dump or child snapshot was captured at timeout, so the exact blocking call and actual leaked child are not proven by current XML alone.
findings.proposal: Small production candidate: refresh exact current process descendants in stop before any parent kill; also sample before cancellation checks in the normal loop. Retain captured ProcessHandles, deepest-first child kills, exact parent kill, existing bounded waits, no shared engine/LSP touches, no new timeout/skip.
findings.needed: Deterministic Windows control cancel after the real helper child/record exists but before first ordinary sample, then require worker completion, both recorded owned identities gone and no reply release; keep pre-start zero-exec and EDT under500ms assertions. Include a separate unowned sentinel still alive. Repeat existing success/output/malformed/guard controls.
findings.residualRisk: A general child-spawns-during-enumeration or already-reparented process race is not eliminated by one refresh; do not claim Windows JobObject-level ownership. If exact physical child cleanup or pipe close still fails, collect only owned worker/reader stack+PID/start/pipe state before designing further changes.

finalBoundary: Keep C506/3229 source and native candidate frozen. Parent may review these unexecuted proposals for a separate future source version; failed Windows preflight is not an installer, release or product PASS.
